decision: Approve promoting main in steps: train 1, then #356 and #432, each only after the full e2e and the data-safety drill pass on that head.

B: one jump to the current train
C: wait for train 7 to be complete
why: `promote:check` refuses a head without e2e, drill and WebKit receipts (promoteCheck 8/8 in the cloud). Small steps keep the rollback to the previous tag under 5 minutes. B mixes 700+ commits into one unreviewable change.
changes: origin/main moves (fast-forward) to each step's head; nothing in the repo changes.
check: git fetch -q origin main && npm run promote:check -- origin/main

changes: None in the repo. Owner session step devices/live-and-merge records the recrawl.

B: paid audit
C: no external review; ship E2EE off
recommendation: A, with C as the state until a report exists
why: All 42 attack tests and 51/51 vectors pass here, but the plan's DoD points at scratchpad files ($S/rr7/*.test.ts) and a script that does not exist (scripts/crypto/vectors.py; the real one is scripts/sync-protocol/check_vectors.py). The DoD fix is proposed in the lane TSV.
changes: plan/plan.json W6.4 dod → `npx vitest run security/attacks` and `python3 scripts/sync-protocol/check_vectors.py` (integrator; plan.json is off-limits to lanes).
